sabau2018.beam_provenance: 80 um selected by the source against these same tracks (reran 70, 80, 100 um, Sabau PDF p31-32); Rubenchik 2018 PDF p8 fn 3 suggests GE IN625 data at D4sigma about 57 um

readings.R40: Gan depth minus 40 um; Sabau unchanged

per_arm_all_of_under_R0_and_R40: source MAPE <= served_reference source MAPE - 2.0 pp, for sabau2018 and gan2021 each
count floor: APE_arm < APE_served on >= 11 of 15 conditions, >= 5 of 9 gan2021, >= 4 of 6 sabau2018
one-sided exact paired sign-flip test on APE_served - APE_arm over 15 conditions, p <= 0.025
completeness: 15 conditions valid for arm, served_reference, baseline, else INCONCLUSIVE
pass_rule.lane_verdict: PASS if at least one scored arm passes; descriptive arms and N3 never produce a PASS
